Res.Caption: Account EFT User ID
Res.FullDescription: Branch Number, as this is usually the same as the Bank Identification Number.

Res.Caption: Account Number
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Account Number.

Res.Caption: GL Account
Res.FullDescription: Enter the GL Account Number or Click to select from the GL Account Number Listing of which this bank account is link to.

Res.Caption: Allow Auto DDR
Res.FullDescription: Tick if automatic deductions by the bank are allowed.

Res.Caption: DDR File Format
Res.FullDescription: The File Format Code or Click to select from Code Listing.

Res.Caption: Bank Abbreviation
Res.FullDescription: Enter the 3-letter code specific to the Bank.

Res.Caption: Bank Account Name
Res.FullDescription: Name of the Bank Account.

Res.Caption: Bank Address
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Address of the Bank.

Res.Caption: Bank Name
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Name of the Bank.

Res.Caption: B S B
Res.FullDescription: The Branch Number of the Bank.

Res.Caption: Number of Check Digits
Res.FullDescription: Enter the number of check digits.

Res.Caption: Closing Balance
Res.FullDescription: The closing Local Currency Balance will be calculated automatically by the system at the point of opening the bank accounting configuration screen.

Res.Caption: Closing Balance
Res.FullDescription: The closing OS Balance will be calculated automatically by the system at the point of opening the bank accounting configuration screen.

Res.Caption: Bank Code
Res.FullDescription: Short code of up to 10 alphanumeric characters.

Res.Caption: Description
Res.FullDescription: Enter a short description for this bank account.

Res.Caption: Detailed Deposit Slip
Res.FullDescription: Tick to enable Printing of Detailed Deposit Supplement.

Res.Caption: Branch
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Branch Code or Click to select from the Branch Code Listing for that branch that uses this bank account. If all branches can use the Bank Account, leave this field as blank.

Res.Caption: Is Active
Res.FullDescription: Tick if the Account is currently Active. Untick if not active and no transactions will be allowed to be posted to this Bank Account.

Res.Caption: Is Default Receipt Bank Account
Res.FullDescription: Tick to set the current Bank Account as the default Bank Account.

Res.Caption: Opening Local Balance
Res.FullDescription: The Local Currency Balance equivalent of the Opening OS Balance carried forward to the opening cashbook period.

Res.Caption: Open Overseas Balance
Res.FullDescription: Foreign Currency Balance carried forward to the opening cashbook period.

Res.Caption: Currency
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Currency in which this bank account is to be kept.

Res.Caption: Show Details on Direct Debits
Res.FullDescription: Tick to roll up individual DDR payments into DDR batch. Rolled up DDR payment will not appear on the Bank Reconciliation screen, only the DDR batch will.

Res.Caption: SWIFT
Res.FullDescription: The Swift Code if known.

Res.Caption: Unique Account Number
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Unique Account Number that identifies the bank account in your country/region
